PATTERN: Ned runs 5k daily (mornings), says it makes 'the whole day feel pretty good.' But has poor hip/glute activation causing recurring issues.
ROUTINE (do before each run, ~5 min):
1. Prone Ws
2. Prone Ys
3. Thoracic extension on foam roller
4. Snow angels on foam roller
5. Scap punches on foam roller
6. Butterflies on foam roller
WHEN: Before morning runs. Purpose: glute activation and hip mobility, preventing injury.
CONTEXT: Part of broader plan to build sustainable daily structure post-ADHD-diagnosis and while waiting for medication.
